title: segment as index plays solar installers
pitch: a manual business process -> an agent that completes it end to end. For solar rooftop installers: Every visual region is a queryable address; ask 'what changed in region 3 since Tuesday' and the segmentation index answers with receipts. Orchestration: hierarchical crew — team leads own subgoals; workers own steps; escalation is explicit. Stack: Muse Spark + Muse Glimmer + Muse Wonder + Muse Voice.

title: chem safety, synthetic contrastive loop edition

title: chem safety, object centric episodic memory edition

title: construction QA, mixture of world agents edition
